title: Fix: Sol review S1/S2 on PR #627 (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Fix the two MATERIAL findings from the Sol final review of PR #627 (read them in full: `bd show eshyra-09co.2`). Work on branch eshyra-09co.3, cut from the PR head (origin/eshyra-09co). Deps installed. A parallel task edits packages/core/src/character/ (creation spell counts) — do not edit packages/core/src/character/.

S1 (flexibleCasting.ts ~129/197/213): before evaluating either transition, obtain the sorcery-point balance THROUGH the usage-counter owner so legacy/alias/duplicate counters (e.g. a declared 'ability:font-of-magic') are adopted into the canonical 'ability:sorcery-points' record counter exactly as spend_usage does (most-spent-alias rule, max/reset/source normalized to the class table). Export one small function from packages/core/src/state/usageCounters.ts (e.g. readBoundClassResourceBalance / reconcile + read for one campaign and character) that reuses the existing reconcileBoundCounterRows logic; do not duplicate it. Then spend/restore that same normalized economy atomically.

S2 (usageCounters.ts ~936 resolveBoundClassResource uses getBundledDnd5eCharacterResolver): resolve the class-level capacity from the ACTIVE campaign rules stack (same as flexibleCasting does: lookupStrictCampaignRecord(db, 'class', sheet.class.key, input.resolveRulesPack) -> createRulesPackCharacterResolver(hit.stack)), thread resolveRulesPack through spend/restore/find paths that call it, and never silently fall back to the bundled progression when a campaign binding exists (fail closed if the class record cannot be resolved from the binding). Keep behaviour identical for the default bundled binding.

EVIDENCE (generalized invariants, as Sol suggested; concise):
- Equivalent canonical, alias-only ('ability:font-of-magic' declared) and duplicate legacy representations yield the same point balance, legality, and slot effect for create and convert, and end as one canonical record counter.
- With an internally consistent add-on binding overriding class:sorcerer's sorceryPoints (and the Font of Magic procedure maximum) to a value below and above the bundled one, create/convert/spend_usage report and persist that maximum, and no extra spend is possible after exhaustion. Use the existing test support for add-on bindings if present (search tests for add-on/override bindings); keep it small.
- Existing usageCounters / levelUpEngine class-resource / flexibleCasting / rest tests stay green.

PROTOCOL: run `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing; commit on eshyra-09co.3; `bd update eshyra-09co.3 --append-notes` with the report; `bd close eshyra-09co.3`. Do not push or open/comment on PRs.
notes: Commit ceecd132.
